d:
Get ready to groove to the energetic Punjabi-style Bollywood track Jatt Lutiya Gaya from the movie Champion featuring Sunny Deol and Manisha Koirala. Sung by Shankar Sahney and Hema Sardesai, this fun-filled Hindi song brings full desi dance vibes and early 2000s Bollywood nostalgia.
Song Details :
Song : Jatt Lutiya Gaya
Singers: Shankar Sahney, Hema Sardesai
Music & Lyricist : Anand Raj Anand
Movie Details :
Cast : Sunny Deol, Manisha Koirala, Master Abhishek Sharma, Rahul Dev
Producer: Sujeet Kumar
